title: Default palette for fourfold displays — fourfold_palette
text: `fourfold_palette()` returns six colours used [geom_fourfold()]. colours encode direction statistical strength association drawn directly geom rather fill scale. Entries 1-2 used `extended = FALSE`, entries 3-4 extended display without adjusted significance, entries 5-6 extended display adjusted significance. Within pair, geom assigns two colours according sign association cell diagonal.

Fourfold displays for 2-by-2 tables — geom_fourfold
text: `geom_fourfold()` draws fourfold display ggplot2 panel. Sector radii represent cell frequencies selected standardization, sector colours, confidence rings, direction ticks show direction strength association.

title: Fourfold displays for 2-by-2 tables — geom_fourfold
code: GeomFourfold  geom_fourfold(   mapping = NULL,   data = NULL,   ...,   std = c("margins", "ind.max", "all.max"),   margin = c(1, 2),   conf_level = 0.95,   extended = TRUE,   ticks = 0.15,   p_adjust_method = stats::p.adjust.methods,   palette = fourfold_palette(),   na.rm = FALSE,   show.legend = FALSE,   inherit.aes = TRUE )

title: Fourfold displays for 2-by-2 tables — geom_fourfold
text: mapping Set aesthetic mappings created [ggplot2::aes()]. supplied `inherit.aes = TRUE`, combined plot's default mappings. data data display layer. `NULL`, default, data inherited plot. ... arguments passed [ggplot2::layer()], typically fixed aesthetics `colour` `linewidth`. std Standardization method. `"margins"` fixes selected margins, `"ind.max"` divides panel largest cell, `".max"` divides every panel largest cell complete layer. margin Integer vector selecting table margins `std = "margins"`. Use `c(1, 2)` margins, `1` `y` margin, `2` `x` margin. conf_level Confidence level `[0, 1)`. Set `0` suppress confidence rings. extended `TRUE`, use adjusted p-values emphasize association draw direction ticks. ticks Non-negative length association direction ticks geom's normalized panel coordinates. p_adjust_method Method passed [stats::p.adjust()] adjustment across panels. Defaults `"holm"`, first value [stats::p.adjust.methods]. palette Character vector least six valid colours semantic order used `fourfold_palette()`. na.rm `FALSE`, default, missing observations removed warning. `TRUE`, removed silently. show.legend Logical indicating whether layer included legends. default `FALSE` semantic fills mapped aesthetic. inherit.aes `FALSE`, override rather combine plot's default aesthetic mappings.

title: Fourfold displays for 2-by-2 tables — geom_fourfold
text: Map two-level horizontal variable `x`, two-level vertical variable `y`, cell frequencies `weight`. `weight` omitted, row counts one observation. first `x` level drawn left second right; first `y` level drawn top second bottom. Set factor levels explicitly order matters. One panel must contain exactly one 2--2 table. Use [ggplot2::facet_grid()] [ggplot2::facet_wrap()] display stratified tables. Duplicate `x`/`y` combinations within panel summed missing cells completed zero counts. Odds ratios, Wald confidence intervals, extended-display p-values match calculations `vcd::fourfold()`. observed cell zero, 0.5 added four cells inference. P-values adjusted across panels layer. Confidence intervals adjusted. six semantic fill colours supplied `palette`; mapped ggplot2 fill scale. Typography layout defaults controlled [theme_fourfold()].

title: Fourfold displays for 2-by-2 tables — geom_fourfold
text: `geom_fourfold()` understands following aesthetics: - `x` (required): variable exactly two levels. - `y` (required): variable exactly two levels. - `weight`: non-negative cell frequencies; defaults `1`. - `colour`, `linewidth`, `alpha`, `size`, `family`: fixed mapped   drawing properties. `size` `family` default values inherited   plot theme.

title: Theme for fourfold displays — theme_fourfold
text: `theme_fourfold()` supplies square, uncluttered panel responsive typography [geom_fourfold()]. also styles facet strips like fourfold stratum headings provides compact spacing remains readable RStudio plot pane exported graphics.

title: Theme for fourfold displays — theme_fourfold
text: base_size Base font size points. base_family Base font family. default, `""`, uses graphics device's default family. ... Additional arguments passed [ggplot2::theme()]. applied fourfold defaults.

title: Theme for fourfold displays — theme_fourfold
text: `base_size` `base_family` control text, including category count labels drawn inside `geom_fourfold()`. labels respond physical panel size retaining readable lower bound. Additional theme elements passed `...` applied last therefore override defaults. theme uses ggplot2's theme-derived geom defaults requires ggplot2 4.0.0 later.
